quality.principle: Evaluate audible defects, not small differences in predicted MOS.
quality.both_good: Both clips have no material audible defect; low model scores alone do not imply bad audio.
quality.guard: Silence and clipping statistics are diagnostic flags, not proof; account for intended pauses and remote transmission artifacts.
quality.unknown: Absence of detected defects is insufficient when recording or detection is unreliable.

speaker_similarity: Compare each response with Input; do not compare transcript identity.
pronunciation: Compare with page target text and instructions. Confirm omissions, additions and mispronunciations with audio; ASR is supporting evidence only.
naturalness: Evaluate fluency, phrasing, stress, intonation, rhythm and unnatural word-by-word delivery. Naturalness MOS is supporting evidence, not a text-aware prosody judge.

overall_preference.principle: Choose according to the most consequential supported differences, without averaging incompatible raw model scores.
overall_preference.normal_case: When both are usable, compare similarity, pronunciation and naturalness; honor current page instructions.
overall_preference.dominant_factor: Record the dimension that actually drove the preference; it is not automatically the largest raw numerical gap.
overall_preference.conflict: Conflicting major defects or weak evidence require human review; no universal priority or weights yet.
